brief.goal: Implement scheduled system notifications that fire 3 times daily (9:00, 12:00, 17:00) showing unread email count with urgent highlights, today's calendar events, and incomplete tasks due today.
brief.constraints: Electron app with native Notification API (REQ-010). SQLite for notification_settings persistence. Depends on existing NotificationService, QuietHoursService, CronScheduler. Must use real data from DB: emails table (classification), calendar_events table, google_tasks/ticktick_tasks tables. Notification delivery within 10 seconds from classification (NFR). Must respect quiet hours and do-not-disturb modes (REQ-013).
brief.non_goals: Per-email urgent notification system (covered by issue #5). Email classification AI logic (covered by issue #15). Calendar data fetching (covered by issue #17). Task CRUD operations (covered by issue #31).
success_criteria: Notifications fire at 9:00, 12:00, 17:00 with configurable per-slot enable/disable
Notification body shows unread email count with urgent highlights, today's remaining calendar events, and incomplete tasks due today
Click notification brings app to focus
Quiet hours suppress all scheduled notifications
Each time slot can be individually enabled/disabled in Settings
Test notification button works in Settings
